## ★★★ THESIS — THE CHANNEL INTO JAKE'S POSITION, AND IT IS THE STRONGEST CRACK-SUPPORTIVE ARGUMENT OF THE WEEK
- **★★★★★★ GAS-TO-OIL SWITCHING IS THE MECHANISM, AND IT IS A *DEMAND* CHANNEL THE US INVENTORY SERIES
  CANNOT SEE.** When European gas is scarce and dear, industrial heat and some power generation switch to
  **gasoil / fuel oil**. ⇒ **Incremental DISTILLATE demand — into a US market already measured BELOW the
  5-year low** (`oil-value-chain`, 8/18: 107,149 vs a 111,490 five-year low). ⇒ **This is a genuine
  reinforcement of the crack thesis and it arrives from a direction the vault was blind to.**
- **⭐⭐⭐ AND IT SUPPLIES A DIRECT TEST OF THE DISCONFIRMER FILED THIS MORNING.** The 8/18 fetch found US
  distillate rebuilding **~48% faster than the 5-yr seasonal norm** — the first real evidence against the
  position. **If Europe is genuinely short, US distillate EXPORTS should rise and arrest that build.**
  ⇒ 🚩🚩🚩 **FETCH: EIA weekly distillate EXPORTS (`WDIEXUS2`). That single series is the bridge between
  the European story and the US inventory data, and it either rescues or confirms this morning's
  disconfirmer.** **This is the highest-value unfetched item in the book right now.**
- **★★★ THE RHINE IS A DISTRIBUTION CONSTRAINT, NOT A SUPPLY ONE — AND IT CUTS BOTH WAYS.** 10cm at Kaub
  with barges at 10-20% capacity **blocks moving gasoil UP-river into southern Germany and Switzerland.**
  ⇒ **Widens INLAND premiums while STRANDING product at ARA (Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp).** ⇒ **Acute
  regional scarcity AND coastal length, simultaneously.** **Unambiguous for regional spreads; ambiguous
  for the benchmark.** ⚠️ **Do not read "Rhine dry" as straightforwardly bullish the diesel crack.**
- **★★★ THE REINFORCING LOOP UBS ONLY HALF-STATES: the Rhine also constrains COAL barges → more gas burn
  → worse storage → higher gas → more gas-to-oil switching.** The river and the storage number are not
  two problems; they are one loop.
- **⛔ THE EL NIÑO LINE IS THE WEAKEST CLAIM IN THE POST AND MAY BE BACKWARDS.** European winter
  temperature is dominated by the **NAO / Atlantic blocking**, not ENSO; ENSO's European signal is weak,
  late-winter, and some literature associates El Niño with a **NEGATIVE late-winter NAO — i.e. COLDER
  northern Europe, not milder.** ⇒ **"Hope for El Niño" is not a hedge; it may be the wrong sign.**
  ⚠️ **Stated as a caution on the claim's confidence, not as a competing forecast — the vault has NO
  weather instrument and should not acquire one casually.** 🚩 **If this thread ever needs weather, the
  variable is NAO/SSW, not ENSO.**
- **↔ THE INFLATION LEG, FOR [[new-economy-regime]]:** at the ECB's 0.6pp-per-10% elasticity, a chase from
  48% toward an 80% mandate is a **policy-relevant** European inflation impulse, not just an energy story.
  ⬜ **Not modelled here. Registered as the link, not the number.**
